newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Highlands to raise A$160 mln equity.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Highlands to raise A$160 mln equity.

text.p: Highlands Gold Ltd said on Tuesday it plans to raise A$160 million through an equity issue as part of a restructuring plan of the gold miner.

Under the restructuring plan Canadian gold mining giant Placer Dome Inc would pay Highlands A$316.1 million to buy the Papua New Guinea (PNG) based miner's 25 percent stake in the Porgera gold mine in PNG.
"It is planned that the total equity raising will be at least A$160 million at an issue price of 30 cents per share," Highlands said.
"It is intended to provide priority to Highlands Gold shareholders in the capital raising," it said.
It said the underwriting arrangements proposed are subject to completion by January 10, 1997.

Under Highlands' proposal all of its assets other than its 25 percent interest in Porgera are to be transferred to a new cmpany Highlands Pacific Ltd in return for the issue to Highlands Gold of 564.5 million share.
Highlands Pacific' assets would be the Ramu nickel/cobalt and Frieda-Nena copper/gold projects as well as its exploration portfolio and database in Papua New Guinea and Indonesia.

"There has been strong institutional interest in our proposal, which unlocks the value of Ramu, Frieda-Nena and Highlands' extensive exploration interests," Highlands managing director Ian Goddard said in a statement.
